complaint: It's giving wrong answers on clinical triage and dosing questions.
cause: The model has a strong systematic bias toward answering "B" on clinical questions (61% of responses vs. ~14% correct), driven primarily by layer 14's MLP and layer 22's linear attention pushing logits toward the B token. I attempted rank-1 edits to subtract the B-pushing component from these layers at 10–30% strength, but every edit either caused unacceptable collateral damage on other tasks (>1% accuracy loss) or failed to raise clinical accuracy meaningfully. The B-bias appears distributed across multiple components in a way that can't be cleanly isolated with small targeted weight changes. I didn't confirm any safe repair that improves clinical performance without degrading other capabilities.
sealed_questions_note: Scored on held-out questions the fixer never saw.
gate_note: The acceptance gate's collateral check and rounding were changed after seeing results; see the backend README, 'Gate changes made after seeing results'.
disclaimer: Research prototype with deliberately damaged models. Not for clinical use. Outputs aren't medical advice. Questions haven't been clinically reviewed.
